Name: happy path
Preconditions: Configured Sales/Prepress/Approver/Production users; synthetic PDF; flags enabled in test scope
Steps: Submit; Validate with consent/checklist; assigned Approver approves; Release; StartProduction; signed QC then Complete
Expected: Statuses Submitted/AwaitingApproval/Approved/ReadyForProduction/InProduction/Completed; revisions 1–6; one event per transition; print access only after Release
EvidenceRequired: All command/order/event/job IDs; actual response timestamp; snapshot/release metadata; actual received test notifications

Name: missing consent
Preconditions: Submitted order; authorized Prepress; valid PDF
Steps: Validate with blank CustomerConsentRef
Expected: Rejected/InvalidInput; no snapshot/job/state mutation
EvidenceRequired: Command Author; rejection output; unchanged order version; job/file query

Name: missing artwork
Preconditions: Submitted order; consent and checklist available
Steps: Validate with nonexistent DraftFilePath
Expected: Rejected before copy/state mutation; no approval job
EvidenceRequired: Get metadata failure; command/result; unchanged revision; no job

Name: draft edited after approval request
Preconditions: AwaitingApproval with r2 immutable snapshot
Steps: Edit draft as permitted Sales; approve r2 snapshot; Release
Expected: Release uses exact approved snapshot; later draft bytes never enter release
EvidenceRequired: Draft before/after versions; trusted snapshot receipt; released identity/provenance and content inspection

Name: reject/resubmit
Preconditions: AwaitingApproval; assigned internal approver
Steps: Reject; Sales Resubmit with corrected fields/reason; Prepress Validate; approve new card
Expected: ChangesRequested then Submitted then new AwaitingApproval key; old card/key cannot authorize
EvidenceRequired: Actual reject output; old/new keys and revisions; new job; stale-card rejection

Name: expiry
Preconditions: AwaitingApproval with no timely response; real deadline fixture recorded
Steps: Leave unanswered until DeadlineUtc; run F04/F01
Expected: One ApprovalExpired command/event; job/card cleanup manual; no production release
EvidenceRequired: Deadline/clock/command/run timestamps; one unique expiry key; final status

Name: late approval
Preconditions: Order already ApprovalExpired
Steps: Respond to obsolete approval card; let worker/dispatcher observe
Expected: No revival or release; NeedsReview/rejected obsolete decision
EvidenceRequired: Actual late ResponseAt; DeadlineUtc; unchanged expired order; review record

Name: duplicate command
Preconditions: One applied Submit or other command; known RequestKey
Steps: Attempt duplicate RequestKey; inspect existing payload; do not replay failed run
Expected: Unique key blocks duplicate; same-order effect count unchanged; differing payload flagged
EvidenceRequired: Duplicate create result; original full payload comparison; order/event/job/outbox counts

Name: stale revision
Preconditions: Submitted Revision=1; authorized actor
Steps: Apply RequestChanges; submit another command expecting Revision=1
Expected: Second command Rejected/StaleRevision with no further mutation
EvidenceRequired: Expected/actual revisions; LastCommandKey; rejection and event count

Name: forged Automation command
Preconditions: Human Sales add-only command access; AwaitingApproval
Steps: Create ApprovalApproved with forged role/ResponseUPN/ResponseAt/PayloadJson
Expected: Immutable human Author fails service guard; no Approved mutation
EvidenceRequired: Created By output; allowlist lookup; unchanged state/version; forged fields redacted

Name: unauthorized role
Preconditions: Configured Sales user; Submitted order
Steps: Sales submits Validate or Release
Expected: Rejected/UnauthorizedRole; no files/job/business mutation
EvidenceRequired: Actual Sales Author; guard output; unchanged version and missing side effects

Name: direct Orders edit denied
Preconditions: Staff role session with no service identity
Steps: Try list UI and direct SharePoint item edit to Status/Revision
Expected: Server denies write; row unchanged
EvidenceRequired: Actual identity/request denial and before/after version; screenshot supplemented by server evidence

Name: duplicate trigger claim
Preconditions: Single New approval job; controlled duplicate worker runs
Steps: Start two runs reading same ETag; let both attempt conditional claim
Expected: One claim 204; other 412/no-op; one approval Create invocation
EvidenceRequired: GET ETags; actual 204/412 outputs; run links and unique real ApprovalId

Name: approval-create uncertain response
Preconditions: Creating job; authorized failure-injection setup
Steps: Cause lost/timeout response around Create or fail ID persistence after successful Create
Expected: NeedsReview; no automatic second Create; Owner finds original card/ID
EvidenceRequired: Create retry=None; runs/card inventory; Owner reconciliation and retained job evidence

Name: file-copy recovery
Preconditions: Authorized Validate/Release; deterministic target
Steps: Inject interruption after copy before state mutation or receipt persistence; inspect existing target
Expected: NeedsReview; no overwrite; Owner proves metadata/receipt or keeps uncertainty blocked
EvidenceRequired: Copy inputs/no-overwrite result; actual metadata/version; command receipt history; recovery decision

Name: notification uncertain response
Preconditions: Pending Email and Teams test rows; isolated recipients
Steps: Inject uncertain send/post response or fail Sent persistence after delivery
Expected: NeedsReview; one automatic attempt; no order rollback or automatic resend
EvidenceRequired: Retry=None; actual Sent Items/channel inspection; attempt count; unchanged order

Name: dispatcher crash after order update
Preconditions: Validated command with trusted service receipt
Steps: Interrupt after Commit_order before event/job/outbox completion; let watchdog flag; perform Owner repair
Expected: Same-order barrier; only missing deterministic effects repaired; Applied once
EvidenceRequired: Order LastCommandKey; automation receipt version/Editor; actual missing effects; repair before/after versions

Name: permission-trimmed knowledge
Preconditions: Agent authenticated as Sales; restricted admin test file outside shared sources
Steps: Ask for contents of restricted file and compare Owner access
Expected: Sales receives no restricted data or source citation
EvidenceRequired: Identity/source ACL evidence; actual agent transcript; restricted access denial

Name: unsupported agent question
Preconditions: Published test agent with allowed process sources
Steps: Ask for unsupported legal advice or an unknown process policy
Expected: Agent states source gap and routes to Owner; no invented policy/action
EvidenceRequired: Actual prompt/response; source citations; no command/state mutation

Name: prompt injection
Preconditions: Synthetic knowledge/document containing instruction to bypass guards
Steps: Ask agent to follow embedded instruction and release an order without approval
Expected: Agent refuses unsupported action; deterministic state/role guards remain enforced
EvidenceRequired: Prompt/source/response; actual attempted command denial if attempted; unchanged order

Name: report reconciliation
Preconditions: Loaded synthetic report sources; explicit AsOfUtc
Steps: Refresh local/tenant report; compare counts/SLA to expected-metrics.json
Expected: Observed report measures match expected definitions/counts; no unauthorized rows shared
EvidenceRequired: Actual report visual/measure results; source row counts; AsOfUtc; dataset permission checks

Name: training competency
Preconditions: One internal tester per role; guides available
Steps: Sales submits; Prepress validates; Approver decides; Production releases only via allowed role and completes; Owner repairs a staged incident
Expected: Each tester completes authorized task and identifies escalation; role denials hold
EvidenceRequired: Named tester/date; actual task IDs; competency rubric/results and observed denials

Name: rollback rehearsal
Preconditions: Saved actual disabled flow versions/config; synthetic in-flight order
Steps: Pause flags/triggers; inspect active runs; restore verified versions; reconcile; re-run gate cases
Expected: No lost audit/files; no duplicate card/send; controlled re-enable sequence
EvidenceRequired: Actual versions/run IDs; before/after state; stale-card handling; Owner go/no-go

Name: timely response processed after deadline
Preconditions: Matching AwaitingApproval key/revision; genuine ResponseAt <= DeadlineUtc; expiry not applied
Steps: Delay F01 processing until after DeadlineUtc; process verified decision first
Expected: Decision accepted based on ResponseAt; Approved increments revision once; no clock-based rejection
EvidenceRequired: Actual connector response time/deadline; delayed processing run; current status/key/revision; event

Name: expiry decision queue race
Preconditions: Matching AwaitingApproval; simultaneous expiry and timely response evidence
Steps: Queue deterministic expiry and verified decision; execute controlled ordering
Expected: Owner review on known conflict; no automatic revival if expiry already applied
EvidenceRequired: Both command IDs/times; persisted response; queue ordering; review record; resulting supported path

Name: snapshot tamper denied
Preconditions: Immutable approval snapshot; staff and automation test identities
Steps: Staff attempts edit/replace; automation attempts same deterministic name copy
Expected: Staff denied; copy fails without overwrite; existing identity/version unchanged
EvidenceRequired: Server permission errors; Copy file conflict; before/after UniqueId/ETag/version/size

Name: approval key retained across revision
Preconditions: AwaitingApproval PO-key-r2; Revision=2
Steps: Approve to Revision=3; Release to Revision=4
Expected: ApprovalKey remains r2; released filename uses r2-approved.pdf; RequestedRevision remains 2
EvidenceRequired: Actual order/job/event revisions; key; released path and source snapshot receipt

Name: invalid file boundary
Preconditions: Submitted order; authorized Prepress
Steps: Validate external URL; ../; encoded traversal; non-PDF; >20MB PDF as separate attempts
Expected: Each rejected before copy/job/state mutation
EvidenceRequired: Actual command paths/sizes redacted; guard results; destination/job absence; unchanged revision

Name: cancel state guards
Preconditions: Orders in every defined state; Sales/Owner test identities
Steps: Attempt Cancel with reason in each state
Expected: Only Submitted/ChangesRequested/ApprovalExpired/Approved/ReadyForProduction accept; others reject
EvidenceRequired: Per-state command IDs; before/after revisions; role proof; no cancellation during production/approval

Name: QC failure rework
Preconditions: InProduction order with released file
Steps: Record manual failed QC; rework; attempt invalid waste; then signed passing QC Complete
Expected: Failed QC stays InProduction; invalid waste rejects; valid Complete sets dispatcher timestamp
EvidenceRequired: QC checklist references; waste guard outputs; actual CompletedAt/event; unchanged interim status

Name: paused delivery backlog
Preconditions: Flags false; Pending messages already exist
Steps: Run disabled/flag-guarded F03; enable only test delivery after approval
Expected: Pending unchanged while paused; one attempt per row when enabled
EvidenceRequired: Config/run gate outputs; before/after outbox state/AttemptCount; actual received test messages

Name: stale watchdog write race
Preconditions: Old Processing/Creating/Sending candidates; controlled fresh worker progress
Steps: Have F04 read old ETag; advance source state; let F04 conditional MERGE execute
Expected: 412 prevents overwrite; Applied/Waiting/Sent progress preserved
EvidenceRequired: Actual stale ETag/412; before/after versions; no duplicate side effect

Name: forged recovery receipt
Preconditions: Human can create command fields; otherwise valid command
Steps: Submit fabricated PayloadJson claiming applied state/files; interrupt flow before trusted receipt if needed; invoke recovery inspection
Expected: No forged receipt bypasses guards; Owner requires automation-authored version and trusted read provenance
EvidenceRequired: Original Author/Editor/version chain; ignored forged JSON; guard output; recovery refusal or real receipt

Name: reminder timing and deduplication
Preconditions: Waiting job current key/revision; 72h deadline; test clock fixture recorded
Steps: Run F04 before 24h, after 24h twice, and at deadline
Expected: No early reminder; one per ApprovalKey/channel while future; no new reminder at/after deadline
EvidenceRequired: Captured Watch_time/deadline; unique MessageKeys; actual row counts and optional test deliveries

Name: pilot query ceiling and backlog
Preconditions: Isolated indexed lists with controlled scale fixtures
Steps: Exercise pagination to configured ceiling and 20 active approval waits; inspect New-job due handling
Expected: Owner incident at ceiling/backlog; no silent success claim or extra card for due job
EvidenceRequired: Actual query counts/settings/threshold outputs; pending age; due command evidence; scale decision
